title: Elon Musk shares 'whole schedule' on how he spends time with his 14 children
content: Elon Musk recently disclosed details regarding his co-parenting schedule for his 14 children. He clarified that his five older children are adults living independently. Musk sees his kids with Claire every other week and his children with Shivon every few days. Contrary to claims, Musk stated that his arrangement is not corporate-like but personal. His children are grouped by their mothers, suggesting limited interaction between half-siblings.

title: Clooneys' foundation gives free legal aid to over 9,000 women and children
content: The Clooney Foundation for Justice is dedicated to empowering women and girls by providing them with free legal assistance. Since its establishment, over 9,000 women and children have benefitted from these crucial legal services. Partnering with local organizations, they have set up mobile legal clinics in underserved areas, ensuring wider accessibility.

title: Barbara Barrie's daughter recalls decision to end her life with medical aid
content: Veteran actress Barbara Barrie, best known for 'Suddenly Susan' and 'Breaking Away', chose medical aid in dying at her Manhattan home after a terminal cancer diagnosis. Her daughter, Jane Harnick, has opened up about the family's support for her decision, the actress' final days and her touching last words: "I love you too."

title: Meet Ayaan Wadhwa, 17: Mumbai teen helps 750 domestic workers get govt benefits
content: Ayaan Wadhwa was inspired to help domestic workers in Mumbai after a personal incident involving financial insecurity. He organized workshops to educate workers about government welfare schemes and assist them in registering for benefits. His efforts have benefitted more than 750 unorganised-sector workers, addressing their lack of awareness. Additionally, he is developing an AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot to simplify contract creation for domestic workers.

title: Melinda French Gates says her 2-day rule helps employees know they did a good job
content: Melinda French Gates implements a 48-hour feedback rule for employees to manage work conflicts effectively. This approach allows employees to feel secure in their performance evaluations as surprises are avoided. She emphasizes the importance of giving honest feedback with integrity while maintaining respect. Recently, Gates pledged $215 million to improve women's health and called for better accountability in healthcare systems.

title: Kerala man sues IRCTC over Rs 1 short refund, wins Rs 3,100 compensation
content: After canceling an AC train ticket, a Kerala resident pursued legal recourse against IRCTC due to a one-rupee refund discrepancy. This issue highlighted the complexities surrounding refund amounts, leading the local consumer commission to find IRCTC liable for service deficiency and to demand compensation. With new cancellation policies being implemented by Indian Railways, travelers will face a new set of guidelines for managing ticket cancellations and refunds.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $325M KC Current opens soccer doors for kids
content: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.

title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf donate $1 million to Las Vegas charity
content: In a heartwarming display of philanthropy, tennis legends Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf pledged $1 million at a charity gala, bolstering the efforts of Keep Memory Alive, which benefits the Cleveland Clinic Lou Ruvo Center for Brain Health. Agassi was honored for his charitable influence during the event in Las Vegas. This recent contribution adds to their previous donation of $1.5 million, bringing their total support to an impressive $2.

title: Tanker with 27 Indian seafarers targeted in first-ever limpet mine attack in Hormuz
content: On October 29 and 30, two oil tankers were targeted in separate attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. MT LOUISE 1 was struck by limpet mines that caused a fire in its engine room. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil export routes, connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. It has faced repeated security incidents since the conflict between US and Iran began.

title: Isro’s NVS-03 launch successful: Navigation satellite placed in orbit; NavIC gets a boost
content: GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -- lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) in Sriharikota at 11.51pm on Friday, as scheduled. Around 18 minutes later, NVS-03 satellite was placed in a geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO) of 37,023km apogee and 170km perigee.

title: Father's death, a promise and Worlds gold: Manisha Bhanwala's story
content: Manisha Bhanwala defeated American Abigail Nette 8-6 in a thrilling comeback victory in the final to become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championships gold. But behind this historic achievement was a personal story of loss, family sacrifices and a promise she had made to herself.

title: Payday to mayday: The hike mirage and why bigger salaries still feel smaller
content: In India, salary increases of approximately 9% are falling short against the backdrop of soaring living costs and inflation. Families are grappling with heightened expenses on essentials like food and fuel, resulting in diminished disposable incomes. This widening gap between income growth and the cost of living places a strain on households, particularly those with fixed financial obligations.

title: Paid to hire, paid to work: Inside India’s Rs 99,446 cr plan to reshape formal workforce
content: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) is introduced to enhance formal employment across various sectors. The scheme includes financial incentives for both employers and first-time employees entering the formal job market. PMVBRY aims to create more than 3.5 crore jobs including 1.92 crore first-time workers by 2027. It targets an increase in manufacturing employment with unique incentives for the sector.

title: $6.3bn gone in 20 mins: How North Korean hackers pulled off biggest crypto heist
content: Hackers executed the largest theft in cryptocurrency history by stealing $6.36 billion from Binance wallets. The theft involved moving funds across 10 blockchains in a short time span. TRM Labs has linked the attack to TraderTraitor, an elite hacking unit from North Korea. Binance has committed to covering all losses through its Secure Asset Fund for Users.

title: ‘Class 12-pass mafia’: Ritabrata Banerjee hits back at Abhishek's warning to cops
content: Ritabrata Banerjee has responded strongly to Abhishek Banerjee's warning issued to West Bengal police officers. He accused Abhishek of arrogance and urged the state government to take action against him. Additionally, Ritabrata challenged Abhishek to visit a temple alone without security, disputing his claim of public support. Abhishek had recently expressed concerns about police targeting TMC workers and claimed to have a list of implicated officers.

title: 'I want teams to fear Mumbai Indians even when we play away': New batting coach
content: Mumbai Indians batting coach Robin Uthappa wants the team to become a force not just at the Wankhede Stadium but also at every other venue in the IPL. He believes the five-time champions must win back the trust of their fans after a disappointing 2025 season. Mumbai Indians finished ninth among 10 teams in IPL 2025. Uthappa knows the team, under head coach Kieron Pollard, has a lot of work to do to return to its winning ways.

title: 'No' to peace bond, 'yes' to INDIA bloc: Has Neha Bora outsmarted CJP leaders?
content: AISA leader Neha Bora's refusal to sign peace bonds led to obvious comparisions with the CJP leadership who opted to comply with conditions set for their release from detention during Jantar Mantar 2.0 protests. The CJP faced significant challenges in organizing Jantar Mantar 2.0 protests which was a contrast from their previous successful mobilization. Bora's determination to protest despite multiple detentions brought her to the centre stage of anti-SIR protests.

title: Two days of rain bring Delhi’s AQI down to 60; minister credits ‘targeted action’
content: Delhi has experienced significant improvements in air quality due to recent rainfall and government initiatives. The average Air Quality Index for October was lower compared to previous years. Rainfall contributed significantly, with over eight times the normal monthly amount recorded. Public participation in anti-pollution measures is acknowledged by officials as a vital factor for change.

title: Manisha Bhanwala becomes India's first women's world wrestling champion
content: In a breathtaking gold medal bout, Manisha overturned a daunting 0-6 deficit to defeat Pan American champion Abigail Nette 8-6. Refusing to surrender despite falling behind early, the Indian wrestler mounted a remarkable comeback to turn the contest on its head and secure a historic victory.

title: Big Tech's AI spending spree puts over $2 trillion in Nasdaq market value at risk
content: As concerns rise over the Nasdaq 100, which faces risks surpassing $2 trillion this month, investors are questioning the viability of major AI investments. With firms like Meta and Alphabet boosting their spending projections, uncertainties around profitability loom large. However, positive results from Microsoft and SpaceX provide a hopeful contrast to an otherwise declining market.

title: Dravid, Sehwag named in India squad for U19 Asia Cup
content: Anvay Dravid and Aaryavir Sehwag have been named in India's squad for the upcoming ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup. The tournament will be held in Muscat, Oman, from November 5 to 14. The 17-year-old Anvay and 19-year-old Aaryavir earned their places after impressive performances in the recently concluded Vinoo Mankad Trophy.

title: Reliance Q2 results: RIL posts record Rs 29,550 crore quarterly profit
content: Reliance Industries Limited announced impressive figures for FY27, with consolidated gross revenue peaking at Rs 3,62,268 crore. The company experienced a remarkable profit growth of 33.8%, reaching Rs 29,550 crore, largely due to a stellar 67.9% rise in oil-to-chemicals segment EBITDA. While retail revenue saw a 6.4% improvement, challenges persisted in that sector. Moreover, the quarter's capital expenditure of Rs 38,153 crore predominantly targeted O2C and New Energy.

title: Two friends turn $15 Denver haunted house into 18 Halloween attractions
content: Two friends, Chris Stafford and Warren Conard, opened a haunted house in a Denver shopping complex in 2002, charging $15 per ticket. What began as a side business has grown into a multimillion-dollar company with 18 seasonal Halloween attractions across the US. The company paid around 4,500 workers during the 2025 Halloween season and is now expanding into Christmas entertainment.

title: On JD(U) 23rd foundation day, party gives credit to Nitish for Bihar’s development
content: JD(U) State president pointed out that while the term “Bihari” had become synonymous with contempt and neglect before 2005, Nitish Kumar, through his efforts, restored honour and self-respect to Bihar and its people

title: Deeply distressing to see ambulances stranded, students missing classes during convoy movement in Kashmir: Sakina Itoo
content: Sakina Ittoo appealed to L-G Sinha “to explore practical traffic management measures that uphold essential security protocols while ensuring uninterrupted passage for ambulances and minimising public inconvenience.”

title: 17 NC MLAs issue 15-day ultimatum to address ‘coterie culture’, other issues in party
content: Four-hour meeting of the 17 NC legislators in Srinagar comes three days after party vice-president and J&K CM Omar Abdullah expanded the Cabinet, leaving several leaders disgruntled at not being given a berth

title: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit
content: The NVS-03, with a mission life of 12 years, is expected to restore the functioning of the NavIC constellation; satellite carries an indigenous atomic clock, along with procured atomic clocks

title: Failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape: Supreme Court
content: Court distinguishes between consent allegedly obtained through deception and regret over consensual intimacy after a relationship ends

title: Election Commission’s appeals against 16.10 lakh cleared voters raise legal questions
content: The officials who filed appeals against the inclusion of the 16.10 lakh voters may not have had the authority to do so under the Representation of the People Act; according to the Act, the CEO/DEO/ERO/AERO are the authorities with respect to electoral rolls

title: Supreme Court asks Centre to take measures against online misuse of court feeds
content: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta submits that suggestions from various High Courts and other stakeholders have been received and forwarded to the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

title: Why is ISRO’s NVS-03 satellite launch crucial? | Explained
content: The mission could help restore the functioning of India’s regional satellite navigation system NavIC; its development began following the 1999 Kargil War, when the U.S reportedly clamped down on GPS data access

title: Haryana BJP MLA questions party’s merit-based jobs policy, warns of anti-incumbency
content: The BJP has consistently projected its policy of providing jobs without political recommendations or bribes as one of its biggest achievements in Haryana

title: Bihar’s interests must be considered in the Ganga Water Treaty: Samrat Choudhary
content: The CM mentioned that Bihar’s rivers hold immense potential for the State, and through the proper management of their water and silt, new opportunities can be created in agriculture, industry, infrastructure, and employment

title: Bengaluru needs long-term master plan for water, roads and sewerage: KBG
content: The Minister said a uniform policy would hold agencies excavating roads accountable for restoration, with clear standards, cost recovery and penalties for violations.

title: CM writes to PM seeking revision of sugar MSP, order on ethanol production
content: The farmers are awaiting an assurance from the Centre even as the cane crushing season has been delayed amidst prospects of cane yield getting reduced this year due to drought: CM

title: 596 polling stations set up for civic body polls in Guntur on November 1
content: In total, 7,75,803 voters to exercise their franchise in Guntur and Tenali; votes to be counted at Acharya Nagarjuna University for Guntur and VSR College for Tenali on November 3

title: U.P. CM prioritised his home turf over 2 Varanasi seats in MLC polls: Akhilesh
content: As per the final tally, declared on Thursday afternoon, of the 11 U.P. Legislative Council seats that went to the polls on October 23, the BJP won six while the SP raised its tally from the previous MLC polls by two

title: Moderate rain likely in south coastal Andhra Pradesh for three days
content: Low-pressure area over Andaman Sea is likely to concentrate into a depression over Bay of Bengal around October 31 and move towards A.P. coast in the next two days, says IMD

title: Andhra Pradesh to spend ₹3,000 crore on irrigation drain modernisation in Godavari region
content: Modernisation of irrigation drains will offer a permanent solution to crop inundation problems, says Chief Minister, adding that 4.68 TMC of rainwater has been diverted to reservoirs during Cyclone Arnab

title: Supreme Court seeks report from ECI on Form 7 misuse allegations
content: Election Commission says it did not accept any Form 7s filed in violation of norms in U.P.; poll officials took prompt corrective steps, it says after Congress MP alleges widespread fraud during SIR

title: Leased forest land at Athirappilly in Keralam to be surveyed amid disputes over blocking elephant corridor
content: Forest department strongly opposes Plantation Corporation, Kerala’s proposal to renew the lease agreement and access more land, citing violation of lease conditions, including engaging private agencies for pineapple farming on the holding

title: Crime Branch nabs PSC additional secretary R. Hari in examination irregularities case
content: R. Hari and P. Satheesh, a former deputy secretary of the PSC, were allegedly in charge of the evaluation process of the controversial exam to the State Planning Board. Satheesh was arrested recently and Hari had been absconding since

title: U.P. CEO directs officials on accurate, error-free and up-to-date maintaining of electoral rolls
content: No officer should share their login credentials, such as user ID, login password and OTP, with any other person, directs Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer

title: Tasmac revises liquor prices from November 1, links refund to bottle returns
content: Environment cess to be added to the existing maximum retail price of Indian Made Foreign Liquor, beer, wine, liquor from other States and imported liquor; those who return the bottles will get a refund of ₹10

title: BIS organises MSME conclave in Ranipet
content: The programme aimed to strengthen awareness among MSMEs regarding standardization, product quality, certification requirements, and the financial and technical assistance available to facilitate compliance with Indian Standards

title: Orders issued on Vigilance probe into KIIFB-financed land acquisition in Kannur
content: Move follows Cabinet nod for VACB probe based on panel report. Procedural lapses alleged in land acquisitions for Kannur industrial zones, where 4,896 acres were bought for ₹12,240 crore amid questions of due diligence, compliance with LARR Act.

title: PCI shocked at inclusion of senior journalist in search warrant requests
content: “PCI condemns all attempts by State authorities to intimidate and harass journalists who are reporting on the ongoing protests against the Siang dam project,” read the statement

title: CMC observes World Stroke Day
content: Interactive stalls, talks in four languages, testimonies from stroke survivors, and a reel-making competition were also held

title: Kashmir issue cannot be addressed through security approach alone, requires political engagement: Mirwaiz
content: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq said peace cannot simply be measured by the absence of protests

title: Maharaja’s College witnesses high drama as SFI activists question Minister Roji amid convocation meet
content: SFI activists allegedly disrupted the meet soon after the Minister completed his inaugural address seeking answers from him about the suspension of 16 students of Sanskrit varsity, Kalady

title: Will not enforce circular on hospital medicine price disclosure for now: Karnataka government to HC
content: The circular mandates that all hospital pharmacies disclose the landing base/purchase price and maximum retail price of medicines, medical devices and consumables on bills.

title: Senior advocate Ancha Pandu Ranga Rao sworn in as APERC member
content: Ancha Pandu Ranga Rao has over three decades of experience practising before Andhra Pradesh High Court, handling writ petitions, civil and criminal cases

title: J&K High Court seeks status on retrieval of Pakistan-born son of Indian deported after Pahalgam attack
content: Scores of Pakistan-born citizens, married to citizens of J&K, were deported from the Union Territory after the Pahalgam attack, which left 26 civilians dead

title: Man, accused of secretly filming woman on Namma Metro, questioned
content: A police officer investigating the case told The Hindu that the accused had obtained anticipatory bail but had been directed by the magistrate to cooperate with the investigation.

title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief
content: Air Marshal Walia headed the Directorate of Air Staff Inspection (DASI) of the IAF, served as the defence attache at Indian embassies in Japan and South Korea, and was the Senior Air Staff Officer of Eastern Air Command.

title: Citizens for Democracy holds mock Parliament on 'Democracy vs Anarchy'
content: Young participants took on the roles of prominent political leaders to debate recent political developments. They enacted parliamentary proceedings, portraying leaders from both the ruling side and the Opposition

title: Two held over death of cheetah; firearm as yet untraced
content: Officials suspect that the weapon used in the shooting is “a country-made bharmar gun”, a traditional single-shot, muzzle-loading smoothbore firearm that is popular is the rural and forest parts of the region.

title: BJP leaders rationalising Chinese actions, says Congress after Arunachal CM’s remarks
content: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh says Mr. Khandu’s remarks contradicted his earlier dismissal of reports of Chinese incursions in Taksing and came a week after the ITBP chief confirmed face-offs at several locations in the State

title: Over 1.05 lakh persons bound over ahead of local body polls in A.P.
content: DGP Harish Kumar Gupta says 2,726 pending NBWs executed and 261 election-related cases registered; police seize liquor worth ₹11.99 lakh and 495 kg of ganja

title: Should Director of Collegiate Education be an academic?
content: Citing administrative reasons, the government appointed an IAS officer to the post starting in January 2024. However, the faculty say day-to-day operations of the department have been affected owing to delays in decision-making

title: G20 Ministers Skip Photo Op In Iran As Russia-Ukraine War Creates Rifts
content: European leaders have opted not to appear in photos with Russian delegations in earlier G20 meetings this year too, as fighting continues after Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

title: Thousands Of Workers, Students Protest In Italy Over High Living Costs
content: The protests were the biggest in a recent wave of demonstrations inspired by those in France and Spain, led by students who have set up tent camps and occupied schools to make their demands heard.

title: Tech Stocks Sell-Off Drags Wall Street Toward Its Worst Day Since June
content: The weakness for technology stocks dragged the Nasdaq composite down a market-leading 3.4%, as of 2:15 pm Eastern time.

content: This incident marked the first successful deployment of limpet mines in the strategic waterway since the conflict began in February.

content: "I challenge both Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav right here and now. The BJP is fully prepared to discuss this in Parliament. We have nothing to hide. Let us convene a special session," Amit Shah said at a party event in Lucknow.

title: Delhi Records Coldest October Day In 75 Years After Heavy Rain, Clean Air
content: The sudden dip in temperatures, with shallow fog during early morning and late evening hours, had residents reaching for warm clothes as the mercury remained well below normal.

title: Independent Russian Newspaper Shuts Down Amid Kremlin Pressure
content: Founded in 1993 after the collapse of the Soviet Union, Novaya Gazeta was one of Russia's most reputable and renowned organisations reporting and documenting human rights abuses.

title: BJP Leader's Singer Wife, A Kabir Bhajan Gone Viral, And The 'Jantar Mantar' That Wasn't
content: A video of Sivasri Skandaprasad's singing performance went viral, interpreted as a dig at protests at Delhi's Jantar Mantar. What she's singing is actually attributed to the saint-poet Kabir, and he did not really mean that particular "jantar mantar". He meant something far more profound.

title: Saudi Coalition Says Intercepted Drone Over Riyadh, Missile In South
content: Earlier on Friday, the coalition said it had intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone in the Mecca region, with the group denying it targeted Islam's holiest city.

title: AAP Claims Government Jobs Halting Punjab Migration, BJP Blames Visa Rules
content: The political exchange began after Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann claimed that young people were increasingly choosing to build their future in Punjab instead of migrating abroad in search of better opportunities.

content: As India moves to tighten oversight of obscene and AI-generated content online, an NDTV test suggests YouTube's existing child-safety safeguards are struggling to keep explicit AI-generated music away from minors.

content: According to Assam police sources, the suspected Bnagladeshi nationals had arrived in Dhubri from Hatsingimari by a motorised boat.

title: Amid Drug Price Cuts, A Look At India's Cancer Burden Against Asian Peers
content: India records around 1.56 million cancer cases and 9,02,000 deaths in 2025, making it the second-most affected country among selected Asian nations, behind only China.

title: Syria dreamed of a new dawn after Assad, but economic misery clouds its future
content: protesters burned tyres, blocked key roads, disrupted crude tanker convoys . rising food, fuel and electricity costs fuelled public anger against new administration . government raised diesel prices by 40 per cent on september 14 .

title: Sena MLA makes shocking remark on farmers' suicide, later clarifies
content: he had asked people not to attend the funerals of farmers who die by suicide . he said he did not mention farmers in his remarks and that he himself came from a farmer's family . this comes as Maharashtra deputy chief minister reportedly upset over gaikwad's remarks .

title: BJP plans counter-protest against oppn's march, 1984 anti-Sikh riots to be in focus
content: 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' protest march at Chandni Chowk in new Delhi . around 5,000 people are expected to participate in the march . members of the Sikh community, especially victims of the 1984 anti-sikh riots and their family members, are also likely to join the BJP's march as the party is gearing up for the upcoing Punjab assembly elections .

title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia appointed IAF vice-chief
content: inderpal Singh Walia will take charge from Sunday . he is the air officer commanding-in-Chief of the Eastern Air Command . in a career spanning almost four decades, the Air Officer has tenanted various command and staff appointments .

title: Population census from Jan 25-Feb 28 2027; poll-bound, snow-bound areas excluded
content: enumeration for 2027 census will be conducted across most of india from January 25 to February 28, 2027 . poll-bound states and snow-bound regions excluded from the schedule . the schedule for manipur will be announced separately .

title: 'Europeans balked': G20 foreign ministers' meeting opens without group photo. Here's why
content: foreign ministers of the largest economies began a two-day meeting in the us on friday . the gathering notably skipping the customary group photograph . several european officials threatened to boycott or walk out over Russia's participation .

content: a seven-month-old order equated the boy's plight with the "human suffering" and estrangement caused by Partition . the court rejects the Bureau of Immigration’s contention that the boy had been deported because he didn’t have an active visa .

content: the attack on MT Louise 1 on October 30 was described by maritime security sources as the first known successful use of limpet mines against a vessel in the region since the US-Iran conflict began in February . the incident comes a day after another tanker, MT Arzanah, carrying two Indian nationals, was targeted in a projectile attack .

content: seven people on board an aryan aviation chopper died when it crashed near Gaurikund on June 15, 2025 . two trans Bharat helicopters were airborne under unsuitable weather conditions . the cause of the crash in which six people lost their lives will be known once the inquiry report is out .

title: 30% in 2019, cancer drug margins at 700% now
content: anti-cancer drugs show mark-ups of up to 700% despite NPPA's 2019 price curbs . a majority of the drugs listed in the 2026 list have breached a trade margin of 43% . this level is equivalent to 30% trade margin because the margin is calcified .

title: Can amend privacy act, revoke law if needed: Government
content: centre open to amend DPDP Act rules or the law itself to address media concerns . senior officials at the ministry for electronics & information technology say sections of the law are applicable to data fiduciaries and they are not for journalists . if necessary, the law is to eliminate the possibility of its application becoming an impediment for journalists and media houses .

title: With 11 more questions, Census 2027 population enumeration phase to be of record 50 days

title: End of SIR doesn't mean freezing of voters list: SC

title: Discourage weaponisation of rape law in relationships gone sour: SC
